tools.name: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown
tools.description: Fetch one public webpage and convert its readable HTML into Markdown. Scripts are not run, and missing text is not filled in. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/url-to-markdown. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: web-intelligence_structured-page-extract
tools.description: Extract caller-defined fields from one public webpage. A field is returned only when a selector, JSON-LD property, or matching meta tag contains it. Otherwise the value is null. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/structured-page-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and

tools.name: web-intelligence_page-change-detect
tools.description: Fetch a public page and compare its Markdown with a caller-supplied previous snapshot. The snapshot is not stored. The result lists added and removed lines and does not rank their importance. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/page-change-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract
tools.description: Read title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, language, and robots directives from one public page. Absent tags are null. robots.txt is not fetched. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/website-metadata-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: web-intelligence_website-contact-extract
tools.description: Read publicly displayed emails, tel: links, address elements, and structured contact data from one public page. Linked pages are not crawled, and missing contacts are not guessed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/website-contact-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms a

tools.name: web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index
tools.description: Fetch one public sitemap or sitemap index and return the listed URLs with lastmod, changefreq, and priority when those fields are present. Page URLs are not fetched. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/web-intelligence/sitemap-content-index. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index · Private data: web-intelligence_website-contact-extract · Public sink: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_structured-page-extract, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index · Destructive: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_structured-page-extract, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index · Private data: web-intelligence_website-contact-extract · Public sink: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_structured-page-extract, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index · Destructive: web-intelligence_url-to-markdown, web-intelligence_structured-page-extract, web-intelligence_page-change-detect, web-intelligence_website-metadata-extract, web-intelligence_website-contact-extract, web-intelligence_sitemap-content-index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
